name: Moises
tagline: A practice app for musicians that separates vocals and instruments from any song.
about: Moises uses AI to split a track into vocals, drums, bass and other parts, so you can practise along, change the key or tempo, and make backing tracks.
pros: Separates vocals, drums, bass and other instruments.
cons: The free plan limits uploads per month.
Separation quality depends on the recording.
